# 129 — US State Dept: Pax Silica Initiative

- **URL:** https://www.state.gov/releases/office-of-the-spokesperson/2025/12/pax-silica-initiative
- **Publisher:** US Department of State, Office of the Spokesperson
- **Published:** 2025-12-11 (Summet convened Dec 12, 2025)
- **Fetched:** 2026-09-14
- **Authoritative:** yes (primary/official government source)

## Key facts recovered

- **Pax Silica** = US-led strategic initiative to build a secure, prosperous, innovation-driven silicon supply chain (critical minerals → energy inputs → advanced manufacturing → semiconductors → AI infrastructure → logistics).
- Goal: reduce coercive dependencies, protect AI foundational materials/capabilities; framed as "positive-sum partnership," not isolation.
- Inaugural **Pax Silica Summit** (Dec 12, 2025) convened by Under Secretary of State for Economic Affairs **Jacob Helberg**.
- Participating countries: **Japan, Republic of Korea, Singapore, Netherlands, UK, Israel, UAE, Australia** (8), plus guest contributions from **Taiwan, EU, Canada, OECD**.
- Named companies/investors: Sony, Hitachi, Fujitsu, Samsung, SK Hynix, Temasek, DeepMind, MGX, Rio Tinto, ASML.
- Deliverables: joint projects on priority critical minerals, semiconductor design/fab/packaging, logistics, compute, energy grids; new joint ventures and strategic co-investment.
